info: Only enter your secret key if you want to sign transactions. Without a secret key, you can only read.
mismatch: The entered secret key does not match the loaded public key.
cleared: Secret key deleted from the session
empty: The Secret Key field is empty.
label: Enter the source Secret-Key (S-Key)

remember.label: Secret Key Remember this for this session
remember.hint: Stored encrypted for this session. Automatically deleted after 15 minutes of inactivity or when you close the tab. Does not protect against active malicious code on this page (XSS).
remember.xssTooltip: XSS (Cross-Site Scripting) means: malicious code executed through a security vulnerability on this page. No storage method can fully protect against active malicious code.
remember.insecureContextError: The Secret Key could not be saved: This feature requires a secure connection (HTTPS). Please access it via an HTTPS address or re-enter the key each time.

multipleSignersThresholdInfo: Threshold for this action: {{threshold}}. Typically, at least {{requiredSigners}} Signer are required (depending on their weights).

localFlow.title: Enter all signatures locally
localFlow.body: In this dialog, you enter all the required secret keys locally on this device. You can then review the transaction in the review dialog before it is signed and sent to the network.
localFlow.stepAllKeys: Enter all required secret keys on this device.
localFlow.stepSend: The transaction is then reviewed in the review dialog before it is signed and sent.

multisigOptions.title: Signature options for this multisig account

distributed.title: Standard: Distributed Multisig-Flow
distributed.body: By default, this session is signed only with your own Secret Key. Additional signatures are added via exported XDR files or a job ID from other Signers.

localAll.title: Enter all signatures locally
localAll.body: Select this option only if you control all Secret Keys associated with this account (e.g., after an account recovery involving multiple Signers). The Stellar Account Manager will then collect all signatures locally and send the transaction directly to Horizon.
localAll.checkboxLabel: Enter all signatures locally in this dialogue and send them directly.
localAll.warning: Note: If you enter all signatures locally, all Secret Keys will be available in this session. Use this option only on trusted devices.

summary.single: This account uses a single signature.

multisigInfo.masterHint: The master account is the currently loaded account from which this operation originates.
multisigInfo.masterExplanation: The master account corresponds to the currently loaded account. Initially, it had all the rights before additional signers were added.

jobSign.masterOnly: Only the master key of this account can sign for this step.
jobSign.anyActive: The master weight is 0. Please enter the Secret Key of one of the listed Signer terms with a weight greater than 0.

status.lockHint: Immediately delete all Secret Keys entries saved during this session
status.canSignHint_one: For this account, {{count}} Secret Key is stored in encrypted form during this browser session. It will be deleted after 15 minutes of inactivity or when the tab is closed.
status.canSignHint_other: For this account, {{count}} Secret Keys are stored in encrypted form during this browser session. They will be deleted after 15 minutes of inactivity or when the tab is closed.
status.viewOnlyHint: There is no Secret Key in this session. You can view everything, but you cannot sign anything.
status.otherAccountHint: No Secret Key is stored for this account, but one is stored for another account in this session. Locking deletes them all.
